title: Raw SQL & Compiled Queries in EF Core

scenes.line2: How do you go beyond it?
scenes.say: Sometimes, LINQ can't handle complex or high-performance queries. So, how do you push EF Core further?

scenes.label: RawSQL
scenes.sub: FromSqlRaw lets you run custom SQL for tough queries.
scenes.say: Raw SQL is your tool for complex queries. With FromSqlRaw, you can run custom statements right from your code.
Compiled queries cache the query plan. That means faster execution for repeated queries with different parameters.
Raw SQL gives you flexibility, while compiled queries boost performance. Both help you go beyond basic LINQ.

scenes.question: How do you speed up repeated queries?
scenes.right: Use compiled queries to cache the query plan and reduce overhead for frequent execution.
scenes.say: Interviewers want more than just raw SQL. For repeated queries, compiled queries are the real performance win.
